attributes.board_name: Vermont Board of Nursing (Office of Professional Regulation, Secretary of State)

rules.alternatives: No APRN-specific CE hours. Renewal requires current certification by a national APRN certifying organization for each specialty (uploaded at renewal), APRN practice of 400 hours in 2 years or 960 hours in 5 years, a current collaborative agreement if required, and meeting RN renewal requirements (practice hours, 20 hours of CE, or national certification) or a multistate RN license.
rules.notes: Biennial licensing period; renewal opens 6 weeks before expiration in OPR Online Services. Vermont RN license holders must renew the RN license before the APRN license.
rules.legal_basis: Administrative Rules of the Vermont Board of Nursing, Rule 4-8(d) (effective May 11, 2023)
